summary: Tested all Stripe-related bug fixes: dotenv override:true fix, CSRF exclusions for Stripe endpoints, and webhook handler behavior. All 10/10 backend tests passed. All 3 critical fixes confirmed working.

dotenv_override_fix.notes: backend/.env STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_... overrides /app/.env rk_live_... key. Server logs confirm '[Stripe] Initialized in TEST mode'. dotenv@17.2.3 loads 16 vars from backend/.env with override:true.

webhook_no_signature_error.notes: POST /api/webhook without stripe-signature returns 'Webhook Error: No stripe-signature header value was provided.' - NOT 'Secret not configured' or 'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY format is invalid'

webhook_alias_no_signature.notes: POST /api/stripe/webhook (alias) also returns correct error: 'Webhook Error: No stripe-signature header value was provided.'

csrf_verify_session_excluded.notes: POST /api/stripe/verify-session with {sessionId: 'cs_test_invalid'} returns Stripe error {'error':'No such checkout.session: cs_test_invalid'} - NOT 'invalid csrf token'. Server logs confirm '[CSRF] Skipping - Stripe order endpoint'

csrf_create_order_excluded.notes: POST /api/stripe/create-order returns validation error (not CSRF 403). Endpoint proceeds to business logic.

csrf_calculate_order_excluded.notes: POST /api/stripe/calculate-order returns {'error':'Event not found'} - not CSRF blocked.

actual_api_responses.POST /api/webhook (no sig): Webhook Error: No stripe-signature header value was provided. (400)
actual_api_responses.POST /api/stripe/webhook (no sig): Webhook Error: No stripe-signature header value was provided. (400)

critical_code_review_comments: NOTE: In stripeWebhookController.js, getStripe() is called OUTSIDE the try/catch block (line 40). If getStripe() throws (e.g., if key override fails), the error would propagate to the global error handler but not return the expected 'Webhook Error:' format. This is acceptable since the fix ensures the key is always valid, but worth noting for robustness.

NOTE: loadPlatformSettingsFromDB() at startup could potentially override STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from the database. If someone stored the rk_live_ key in platform_settings table, it would override the backend/.env fix. Low risk in test env but should be monitored.
VERIFIED: dotenv@17.2.3 override:true correctly ensures backend/.env sk_test_ key takes priority over root /app/.env rk_live_ key.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 critical Stripe fixes verified: (1) dotenv override:true working - sk_test_ key in use, (2) CSRF exclusion for /stripe/verify-session and other Stripe endpoints working, (3) Webhook returns correct 'No stripe-signature' error (not key config error). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_fixes.py. Previous tests (iteration_58) verified Firebase fix and auth 401 messages - those still passing.

dotenv_override_fix.root_cause: /app/.env had STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=rk_live_... (restricted key, not a standard secret key). server.js loaded root .env first, then backend/.env, but without override:true, the rk_live_ value persisted. getValidatedStripe() validates key starts with 'sk_' so rk_live_ caused 'format is invalid' error.
dotenv_override_fix.fix_applied: Added override:true to second dotenv.config call in server.js (line 20). Now backend/.env sk_test_... key overrides root .env rk_live_ key.
dotenv_override_fix.verification: Server logs: '[Stripe] Initialized in TEST mode'. Webhook returns signature error (not key format error).

csrf_verify_session_fix.root_cause: csrfMiddleware in server.js was applying CSRF protection to /api/stripe/verify-session because it wasn't in the exclusion list.
csrf_verify_session_fix.fix_applied: Added verify-session to CSRF exclusion conditions (lines 287-291 of server.js): `req.path === '/stripe/verify-session'`
csrf_verify_session_fix.verification: Server logs: '[CSRF] Skipping - Stripe order endpoint' for verify-session. API returns Stripe error not CSRF error.
